name: 音声の入力と出力を整える設定シート
prompt:
Create version 2 of the same crisp flat Japanese audio settings screen at exactly 390×514 pixels. Use the native preview as exact source of truth, and use candidate v001 only to retain its clean white card treatment and icon style.

No tinted colors on surfaces: the full page and both cards are pure white #FFFFFF, with only a thin neutral #E8ECE9 outline and 12px corners. No mint, pastel, colored wash, gradient, glow, or decorative color. Keep forest green #047857 only for the live voice-detection bar, the ON sensitivity switch, and the volume value segment because these are meaningful active states. Use slate #526173 for the two speaker icons. There is no hyperlink in this component; use no blue text and do not add a help link.

Correct the geometry that drifted in v001. The canvas must stay 390×514 with these exact source positions: title 音声の設定 centered in x24 y10 w342 h28; 入力 section label x16 y70; input card x16 y104 w358 h256; output section label 出力 x16 y386; output card x16 y420 w358 h92. In v001 the cards spread too far sideways and sit too high. Move them to those exact source coordinates and narrow them to the given 358px width. Align all card contents to the native preview: x30 left text inset, x190 right-side input-mode text, divider x30–360 at y160, sensitivity switch x310 y183, sensitivity value rail x30 y284 w328, helper copy x30 y308, volume speaker icons x32 and x336 at y471, output rail x72 y478 w236, green value segment w168, and white knob x230 y468. Keep all Japanese wording exactly as shown in the native preview. Maintain the saved Meiryo family and roles: title Bold 20px; card headings Bold 14px; secondary text Regular 12px. Preserve the native line breaks in the helper copy.

Do not add numbers, wallpaper, artwork, source-only troubleshooting text, extra icons or controls, or a device frame. Return only the finished screen, flat and front-facing, with no surrounding margin.
reviewNotes: No tinted surfaces: white page and white cards remain, with green only on the semantic active switch/detection/volume values and slate speaker icons. The native has no hyperlink. v002 remains about 7px too wide; the input card starts about 11px too high; output card is about 10px high and short. Two bounded renders complete; retain needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.purpose: Second and final bounded geometry pass: restore source card bounds while retaining user-directed white no-tint surfaces and semantic green control states.
